name: artifactdle
description: A Wordle-inspired game for guessing artifact sets from Genshin Impact.

paragraphs: Artifactdle is a Wordle-style game for guessing artifact sets from Genshin Impact. You pick an artifact set from the list of sets, and get guess feedback based on the set's region, 2pc and 4pc buffs and release version, with the aim of guessing the randomly selected artifact set within five guesses. The game features a daily mode, as well as infinite. Additionally, different game modes such as normal , silhouette and build are available. Built with React, Tailwind and Framer Motion, and inspired by the already exisitng Genshindle, but for artifact sets.
If you enjoy or use this project, feel free to leave it a star! ;) 🫶
